notes: Told in Genesis 7-8, and in the Qur'an. Dated here as year 1656 of the world in the Masoretic Text chronology, converted to BCE with the same offset the Wikipedia table uses (4164 minus the year of the world). Other chronologies place it centuries apart.
Most scholars assume a date of birth between 6 and 4 BC.
Scholars estimate that his preaching began around AD 27-29 and lasted one to three years.
Scholars calculate the death of Jesus as having taken place between AD 30 and 36.
